articles.title: College football game delays, schedule updates, how to watch: USC vs. Indiana, Texas vs. LSU, Utah vs. Arizona and more
articles.summary: The fun sprint to the finish of the 2026 college football regular season got waylaid Friday due to travel complications by several Power Four teams.
articles.body: The fun sprint to the finish of the 2026 college football regular season got waylaid Friday due to travel complications by several Power Four teams following the FAA’s nationwide ground stop.There are several programs with changing game times or one game has even moved to Sunday (Ole Miss vs. Oklahoma). We'll be keeping everybody posted as decisions are made.Week 11 features five games between teams in the top 25 of the College Football Playoff rankings and a host of other games between ranked teams and opponents who aren't that far outside the rankings. Here are the games we'll be watching closely on Saturday:Duke vs. Miami, 12 ET (ABC)Wake Forest vs. SMU, 12 ET (ESPN)Northwestern vs. OSU, 12 ET (Fox)Missouri vs. Georgia, 3:30 ET (ABC)USC vs. Indiana, 3:30 ET (CBS)Michigan vs. Oregon, 3:30 ET (FS1)Florida vs. Kentucky, 7 ET (ESPN)Baylor vs. BYU, 7 ET (Fox)Texas vs. LSU, 7:30 ET (ABC)Texas Tech vs. OK State, 9:30 ET (ESPN)Utah vs. Arizona, 10:30 ET (Fox)Follow along below for highlights, analysis and more:
